# @canopy/tanstack-db

Canopy collections as TanStack DB collections: synced from realtime live queries, written through Canopy mutations.

Part of [Canopy](https://github.com/FlazexHQ/Canopy), an open source, self hostable backend platform for MongoDB. Nothing is
published to npm yet: until then, use it from a clone of the repository.

## Install

```bash
bun add @canopy/tanstack-db @canopy/client @tanstack/db
```

`pnpm add`, `yarn add` and `npm install` take the same names.

## Use

```ts
import { canopyCollectionOptions } from "@canopy/tanstack-db"
import { createCollection } from "@tanstack/db"

const todos = createCollection(
  canopyCollectionOptions({ client: canopy, collection: "todos", filter: { done: false }, limit: 500 }),
)
await todos.preload()
todos.insert({ _id: crypto.randomUUID(), title: "Write docs", done: false })
```
